projects.title: Apple Stock Price Prediction
projects.description: LSTM deep-learning forecasting pipeline built with TensorFlow and Keras, with an interactive Streamlit deployment for exploring Apple stock predictions.
projects.problem: Forecast future Apple stock prices from historical market trends to support data-driven investment analysis.
projects.solution: End-to-end ML pipeline covering data collection, cleaning, feature engineering and normalization, followed by LSTM model training, prediction, evaluation and an interactive Streamlit interface for exploring forecasts.
projects.outcome: A completed deep-learning project demonstrating the full time-series forecasting workflow — from raw market data to a deployed Streamlit app as supporting technical analytics work.
projects.resumeSummary: Built an LSTM-based Apple stock price prediction system in Python (TensorFlow/Keras) with a Streamlit interface for interactive forecasting.
projects.interviewExplanation: I framed this as a time-series forecasting problem: collect historical Apple prices, clean and normalize the series, engineer lag features, then train an LSTM in TensorFlow/Keras. I evaluate the model on held-out data and expose predictions through a Streamlit app so the workflow is interactive end-to-end. It's the project I use to explain deep learning for sequences and the full data-science lifecycle.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.description: Customer churn analysis across 7,000+ records using cleaning, EDA, feature engineering and comparative model evaluation.
projects.problem: Customer teams need a structured way to identify accounts with a higher likelihood of churn and understand the factors associated with attrition.
projects.solution: Cleaned and explored the data, engineered features, and evaluated Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest and XGBoost using Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, ROC-AUC and a confusion matrix.
projects.outcome: A completed comparative classification workflow for identifying behavioral patterns associated with churn.
projects.resumeSummary: Analyzed 7,000+ customer records and compared four churn-classification approaches using multiple evaluation metrics.
projects.interviewExplanation: I cleaned and explored more than 7,000 customer records, engineered model features, then compared Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest and XGBoost using Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, ROC-AUC and a confusion matrix.

projects.title: SQL Data Warehouse & ETL Pipeline
projects.description: SQL and Python ETL workflow centralizing four operational sources across 12 normalized tables for consistent reporting.
projects.problem: Centralize fragmented business data for consistent reporting and analysis across multiple operational sources.
projects.solution: Designed an ETL workflow using SQL, MySQL, Python and Pandas to extract, cleanse, transform, validate and reconcile data from four sources across 12 normalized tables.
projects.outcome: A reporting-ready warehouse that the verified resume reports reduced manual data-preparation effort by approximately 60%.
projects.resumeSummary: Built a SQL and Python ETL pipeline across four operational sources and 12 normalized tables.
projects.interviewExplanation: I centralized four fragmented operational sources into a normalized warehouse, then used Python, Pandas and SQL for cleansing, transformation, validation and reconciliation before connecting the outputs to Power BI.

keyFindings: Approximately 60% lower manual data-preparation effort reported in the verified resume

projects.title: Sales Performance Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive sales-performance dashboard centralizing 15+ KPIs across 50,000+ sales records.
projects.problem: Centralize KPI monitoring and provide clear visibility into business performance.
projects.solution: Prepared data with Power Query, created DAX measures for Revenue, Profit, Profit Margin, AOV and YoY Sales Growth, and added KPI cards, filters, slicers, drill-throughs and trend views.
projects.outcome: A recurring reporting solution that the verified resume reports reduced manual reporting effort by approximately 70% and improved KPI visibility.
projects.resumeSummary: Built an interactive Power BI sales-performance dashboard across 50,000+ records and 15+ KPIs.
projects.interviewExplanation: I prepared and transformed the sales data with Power Query, created DAX measures for core KPIs, and built an interactive reporting view with filters, slicers, drill-throughs and trend analysis.

keyFindings: Approximately 70% lower manual reporting effort reported in the verified resume
evidence.businessOutcome: Improved KPI visibility and recurring management reporting

projects.title: Product Recommendation System
projects.description: Python recommendation prototype using Pandas, NumPy and Scikit-learn to generate ranked product suggestions.
projects.problem: Explore product recommendations from user and product interaction patterns.
projects.solution: Clean interaction data, create a user-item structure, compute similarity and rank Top-N suggestions.
projects.outcome: Supporting technical work with a repository link stored in the portfolio.
projects.resumeSummary: Built a product recommendation prototype using Python, Pandas, NumPy and Scikit-learn.
projects.interviewExplanation: A supporting technical project that prepares interaction data, computes similarity and ranks product suggestions.
